bio.text: Sarah Keitt represents Fairfield and Trumbull in the Connecticut House and, in her second term, is an Assistant Majority Leader and Vice-Chair of the Commerce Committee.
She holds a master's degree in public health from George Washington University and has over 20 years of experience as a public health advocate.
Keitt is a former adjunct instructor in community health at George Washington University and moved to Fairfield in 2016.
